issues.explanation: This is a genuine fixed expression meaning “wake up,” so its components should be kept together.
issues.suggested_fix: Annotate 目を覚ます as one fixed-idiom segment.

issues.explanation: In this context, 目から火が出る is the established idiom “to see stars” after a blow.
issues.suggested_fix: Annotate 目から火が出た as one fixed-idiom segment, with the past inflection represented appropriately.

issues.explanation: 姿を消す is a fixed expression meaning “disappear,” rather than ordinary compositional 姿 + を + 消す.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep 姿を消す together as a fixed idiom, then annotate ている separately as the aspectual auxiliary.

issues.explanation: 覚ます is transitive “wake someone/something up”; “wake up” is the idiomatic meaning of the full expression 目を覚ます.
issues.suggested_fix: If retaining separate tokens, change the lexical meaning to “awaken; wake up (something)”.
